name: engineering-plan-change-review

content.title: Review an engineering change plan
content.body: Plan: add a bounded retry, tests, and rollback flag. No repository write is performed by this example.

payload.consequence: Authorize an external coding agent to implement change-set-001 and return a diff for review; Commentary will not edit or merge code.

expectedConsequence: An external coding agent may prepare a diff for change-set-001; Commentary neither edits nor merges the repository.

revision.title: Review revised engineering change plan
revision.body: Adds explicit retry ceiling, test lane, and rollback flag.

payload.consequence: Authorize an external coding agent to prepare the revised diff; Commentary will not edit or merge code.
